errors.source_evidence: The page is a 1623px-wide form. Each section sits in its own box, laid out top to bottom: header, shipper/consignee/notify, vessel/ports, cargo table, charges, signature, footer.
errors.html_evidence: The render collapses every block into the top ~680px. Cells overlap each other and the text is stacked and unreadable, even though the CSS gives absolute positions for a 2136px-wide page. A stray extra `}` in the stylesheet (`color:#111}}`) breaks the following rules, including `.block{position:absolute}`.
errors.correction: Fix the CSS syntax error (the extra brace). Make the block and cell positions work so each section lies in its own area without overlapping.

errors.source_evidence: The footer at the bottom of the page reads 'MRS RAJWINDER HOTHI & MR MANISH BHATT • +44 1246 854987 • removals@simpsons.co.uk'.
errors.html_evidence: The HTML has no footer text.
errors.correction: Add the footer line with the names, phone number and email.

errors.source_evidence: The header block shows 'HEMISPHERE LOGISTICS' above the address lines, and the B/L box title is 'BILL OF LADING No.'. The signature area shows 'Hemisphere Logistics' on a dark redaction bar, followed by the large 'Agent Signature' text.
errors.html_evidence: All of this text is present, but it is merged into a few lines. The signature cell has no separate placement for the redaction bars or the large signature text.
errors.correction: Position the signature area separately from the surrounding cells, with the redaction bars and the large 'Agent Signature' text kept distinct.

errors.source_evidence: The legal text box 'RECEIVED by the Carrier...' is small print contained in its own cell on the right of the charges table, next to the Freight & Charges grid, with a different cell width and font size from the surrounding text.
errors.html_evidence: The legal text renders in bold, oversized type (the block-7 rule makes all its text bold) and spills over the neighbouring cells. In the source it is small, regular-weight text.
errors.correction: Apply the bold style to the charge headers only, not to the legal text. Reduce the font size and keep the text inside its own cell.

errors.source_evidence: The 'Total: 2,500 kgs.' and '25.000 cu. m.' values sit at the bottom of the weight and measurement columns, under a rule line.
errors.html_evidence: The totals appear in cells that are shown far from the cargo table because the layout is broken.
errors.correction: Place the totals at the bottom of the weight and measurement columns, in line with the cargo description.

errors.source_evidence: The cargo table has column headers (Container Numbers, Description, Gross Cargo Weight, Measurement) with the data rows beneath, and the freight charges table has columns FREIGHT & CHARGES / BASIS / RATE / PREPAID / COLLECT above an empty body.
errors.html_evidence: The tables are built from absolute-positioned divs, not semantic table markup, and the rendered cells overlap (the charge headers sit on top of the cargo data).
errors.correction: Use semantic <table> elements with correct rows and columns, or at least non-overlapping grid layout.

errors.source_evidence: The bold and emphasized names (e.g. shipper name, consignee name, notify name, vessel name, BuildMat Solutions) are bold, and the B/L number block is large and bold in a bordered box.
errors.html_evidence: The HTML renders almost all text in a single plain style; bold is applied incorrectly to the cargo headers and the legal terms (block-7 whole legal text bold) instead of the proper elements.
errors.correction: Apply bold only where the source does, and make the legal terms small, regular text.

errors.source_evidence: Source signature area shows 'Hemisphere Logistics' in a highlighted/redacted bar plus a large 'Agent Signature', and a footer line 'MRS RAJWINDER HOTHI & MR MANISH BHATT • +44 1246 854987 • removals@simpsons.co.uk'.

errors.correction: Add the footer: 'MRS RAJWINDER HOTHI & MR MANISH BHATT • +44 1246 854987 • removals@simpsons.co.uk'.

errors.correction: Fix the CSS syntax error and positioning so each block renders in its own region, with no overlapping text.

errors.source_evidence: Reading order runs top to bottom: header, shipper and endorsements, consignee, notify parties, vessel/ports, cargo, charges, signature.

errors.correction: Apply bold only to headings and key values, and render the legal terms in small regular text.
